tests.why: launch → mass, diff center split, accel spin

tests.why: WOT time in every gear → gearing tab

tests.why: full-throttle through the rev range → engine/aspiration curve

turns.note: 200 turns on record · 1 lap — drive 2 more to confirm the turn count · C64, C195 often split into several detections (taken inconsistently)

2616|2|10|800.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
2616|2|10|800.evidence: USI median +0.332 over 202 corners (150 understeer, 13 mid-corner front reds)

2616|2|10|800.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
2616|2|10|800.evidence: 110/202 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

2616|2|10|800.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
2616|2|10|800.evidence: 75921 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

2616|2|10|800.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
2616|2|10|800.evidence: median peak rear slip 21.82; 1/1 launches spun

2616|2|10|800.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Fronts run 15 F+ hotter than rears: the understeer thermal signature — check pressures/camber on the HUD (Tires Misc + Heat).
2616|2|10|800.evidence: median F 212 F vs R 185 F

2616|2|10|800.text: Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.47) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 28 stops (0 both-axle, 6 front-first, 0 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
